'''Sergei Mironovich Aseev''' ({{langx|ru|Сергéй Миро́нович Асéев}}; born 4 December 1957) is a [[Russian mathematician]], [[Doctor of Science|Dr. Sc.]], [[Professor (highest academic rank)|Professor]], and a [[Corresponding Member]] of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>[http://en.cs.msu.ru/persons/336 MSU CMC]{{in lang|ru}}</ref>

He graduated from the faculty of [[MSU CMC]] in 1980.

He defended the thesis «Extremal problems for differential inclusions with phase constraints» for the degree of [[Doctor of Science|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]] (1998).

Was awarded the title of [[Corresponding Member]] of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] (2008).<ref>[http://isaran.ru/?guid=932DC942-6B76-CC8D-2307-57E9402D0CDA&q=ru/person Russian Academy of Sciences]{{in lang|ru}}</ref>

Author of 1 book and more than 30 scientific articles.<ref name="istina">{{cite web|url=https://istina.msu.ru/profile/smaseev/|title=Асеев Сергей Миронович - пользователь, сотрудник &#124; ИСТИНА – Интеллектуальная Система Тематического Исследования НАукометрических данных|website=istina.msu.ru|accessdate=2018-05-24}}</ref><ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?personid=8838&option_lang=&option_lang=eng Scientific works of Sergei Aseev]{{in lang|en}}</ref>

'''Area of scientific interests''': The theory of multivalued mappings, optimal control, and mathematical models in economics.<ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?personid=8838&option_lang=&option_lang=eng Scientific works of Sergei Aseev]{{in lang|en}}</ref>
